title: nf-g4rnaseq: RNA-seq differential expression + G-quadruplex / RNA:DNA hybrid-G4 (PHQS) analysis pipeline
description: A configurable Nextflow (DSL2) pipeline for RNA-seq differential expression integrated with G-quadruplex (G4) prediction and co-transcriptional RNA:DNA hybrid-G4 (PHQS) analysis, including GO/KEGG enrichment and GSEA. Sample-sheet + contrasts driven; FASTQ/BAM/count-matrix entry points; organism-configurable; containerized.
